 Advertisement Country star Cody Johnson won't attend CMA Awards: 'Going 100 mph all the time isn't healthy'
 Advertisement Updated: 9:22 AM CST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Caitlyn Scott Digital Producer Country star Cody Johnson won't attend CMA Awards: 'Going 100 mph all the time isn't healthy'
 Updated: 9:22 AM CST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Caitlyn Scott Digital Producer Country singer Cody Johnson says he will not be attending the 2026 CMA Awards. 
 In a social media post , Johnson said after getting sick at the end of his tour in the United Kingdom earlier this month, he "realized much of it stemmed from mental and physical exhaustion," further saying he needs to step back from the award show. 
 Advertisement "At the end of the day, I'm a human being, no matter how much I tell myself and others I'm superman," Johnson said. "I have everything to be thankful for, but sometimes I put too much pressure on myself." 
 Related video: Carrot Top at the 2006 Billboard Music Awards 
 When talking about his career and the long wait it took to get to where he is today, he said although it was well worth it, "going 100 mph all the time isn't healthy." 
 Johnson says he is going to take time recouping at home with his family. 
 The announcement comes hours ahead of the 60th annual CMA Awards Wednesday night.
